title: Make the federation retained-lookup yield regression independent of a one-second scheduling deadline
outcome: The retained SQLite lookup regression proves the async worker yields while storage is held without treating a slow thread start or first poll as a product defect.
acceptance: Use explicit synchronization to distinguish blocked inline SQLite lookup from an offloaded lookup while the connection remains held; avoid a one-second wall-clock performance threshold deciding correctness.
Retain detection of the original blocking implementation and safe cleanup on failure; use any timeout only as a bounded hang guard consistent with project policy.
